title: KMM PR Review Finding
description: Every finding emitted by a specialist must validate against this schema. Findings that fail validation are dropped by the aggregator with a logged warning.

rule_id.description: Stable rule ID from references/rules/*.md (e.g. 'S-EA-02', 'I-READY-04', 'NC-01', 'M-PARITY-01'). For findings researched via Context7/web_search and not in references/, use 'AD-HOC-<short-slug>'.

line.description: 1-based line number in the file as it exists in the PR. For findings spanning multiple lines, use the first line.

line_end.description: Optional last line of a multi-line finding.

severity.description: Base severity per the rule. Opus may re-prioritize during aggregation (attribution gate caps pre-existing at P3; migration PRs auto-promote iOS-blocking findings to P0).

why.description: 1-3 sentences. The reason the rule fires here, in the context of the PR. Cite the canonical source's specific guidance briefly.

suggestion.description: Concrete fix. Prefer code snippets where helpful. May offer two alternatives if both are valid.

source.description: URL to a tier-1 canonical source OR a 'references/rules/<file>.md#<rule-id>' reference. Required. No source -> drop the finding.

attribution.description: Specialist's best determination. Opus may revise during aggregation. 'unknown' is acceptable when the specialist can't make a confident call.

confidence.description: Specialist's confidence. Medium/low findings get extra Opus scrutiny.

iOS_blocking.description: True if this finding would block iOS consumption. For migration PRs, true findings auto-promote to P0 regardless of base severity.

context.description: Optional. The relevant code snippet (a few lines) for the aggregator to verify against master and other specialists' findings.
